_schema._about: Content for /404 (dist/404/index.html, also served for any unmatched route by vercel.json). A short black page: eyebrow, display h1, one paragraph, a primary pill and a row of four text links, with the small HQ line drawing (the same one the footer uses) sitting bottom-left. British English.
_schema.meta: {path, title, description, theme, robots} - robots 'noindex' goes into a meta tag.
_schema.hero: {eyebrow, h1, p, primary:{label, href}, links:[{label, href}], art:{kind, alt}} - art.kind = 'hq-drawing-small' means reuse the footer's small HQ drawing at ~280px wide.
